title: 第一百章  剽悍的嫂子
slug: 替弟入赘后我被女帝赖上了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

严腾挑了挑眉，有些好笑地看着他。

“赌一把大的？李少将军，本将若是没记错的话，你现在身上可是连一个铜板都掏不出来了吧，你拿什么跟我们赌？”

李少云咬了咬牙。

“这一次，咱们不单打独斗了，咱们直接赌三匹马，三局两胜，就用刚才出过场的那三匹马，赌注一万两，你们敢不敢接？”

一万两！

这个数字一说出口，不仅严腾等人愣住了，就连周围围观的那些世家子弟们，也纷纷倒吸了一口凉气。

“一万两白银，这李少将军莫不是疯了？”

“他去哪儿弄一万两银子，难不成要把大将军府给卖了？”

低声的议论声在人群中蔓延开来，所有人看向李少云的眼神都像是在看一个疯子。

严腾微微眯起眼睛，冷笑一声。

“李少云，空口白牙的，你拿什么证明你有一万两？”

“若是你输了拿不出银子，难不成还要本将去大将军府找李老将军要债？”

李少云脸色涨得通红，梗着脖子喊道：

“你们给老子在这里等着，老子现在就去拿银子，谁要是走了，谁就是孙子！”

说完，李少云连滚带爬地朝着马场外跑去，甚至因为跑得太急，还险些在空地上摔了个狗吃屎。

没过多久，马场入口处便传来了一阵有些喧闹的声音，伴随着一阵清脆却带着几分泼辣的娇喝声。

“李少云，你这个败家玩意，你给老娘站住！”

众人循声望去，只见李少云正龇牙咧嘴地被人拧着耳朵，一路小跑着往回走。

而拧着他耳朵的，竟是一个身着红色劲装、身材高挑、长相颇为英气却满脸怒容的年轻少女。

顾淮看着这一幕，整个人顿时愣住。

他早听说李少云的媳妇儿是洛安城出了名的悍妇，难不成这就是那个嫂子？元氏商行的千金大小姐元灵？

“哎呦，疼疼疼，媳妇儿，你轻点，这么多人看着呢，给夫君留点面子成不成？”

李少云一边歪着脑袋顺着那女子的手劲往前走，一边苦苦哀求着，哪里还有半点刚才在马场上面对严腾时的嚣张气焰。

周围的世家子弟们也是纷纷低声议论，脸上皆是露出了看好戏的表情。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Yan Teng raised his eyebrows and looked at him amusedly.

"A big bet? General Li, if I remember correctly, you can't even take out a copper coin from your body right now. What are you betting on us for?"

Li Shaoyun gritted his teeth.

"This time, we won't fight alone. We will directly bet on three horses. We will win two out of three games. We will use the three horses that just played. The bet is 10,000 taels. Do you dare to take it?"

Ten thousand taels!

As soon as this number was spoken, not only Yan Teng and others were stunned, but also the children of the aristocratic families who were watching around them took a breath.

"Ten thousand taels of silver, is this Major General Li crazy?"

"Where can he get ten thousand taels of silver? Could it be that he wants to sell the general's mansion?"

Low voices of discussion spread among the crowd, and everyone looked at Li Shaoyun as if they were looking at a madman.

Yan Teng narrowed his eyes slightly and sneered.

"Li Shaoyun, you are just talking nonsense, how can you prove that you have ten thousand taels?"

"If you lose and can't get the money, is it possible that I have to go to the General's Mansion to ask General Li to collect the debt?"

Li Shaoyun's face turned red, he held his neck and shouted:

"You wait here for me, I will go get the money now. If anyone leaves, he will be my grandson!"

After saying that, Li Shaoyun rolled and ran towards the outside of the racecourse, and even almost fell into the open space because he ran too fast.

Not long after, there was a burst of noisy sounds at the entrance of the racecourse, accompanied by a crisp but somewhat shrewd shout.

"Li Shaoyun, you wasteful thing, stop here!"

Everyone followed the sound and saw Li Shaoyun grinning and having his ears pinched, trotting back all the way.

The person who was twisting his ears was actually a tall young girl wearing a red outfit, with a rather heroic appearance but an angry look on her face.

Gu Huai was stunned when he saw this scene.

He had long heard that Li Shaoyun's wife was a well-known shrew in Luo'an City. Could this be that sister-in-law?Yuan Ling, the daughter of Yuan's Trading Company?

"Oh, it hurts. Wife, please be gentle. There are so many people watching. Can you save some face for your husband?"

Li Shaoyun tilted his head and followed the strength of the woman's hand, while begging bitterly. There was no trace of the arrogance he had when he faced Yan Teng on the racecourse.

The disciples of the surrounding aristocratic families also talked in low voices, with expressions on their faces that they were watching a good show.
